name: Cherub Suite
tagline: Comprehensive pie menu system for fast modeling workflows
description:
Cherub Suite is a comprehensive modeling toolkit for Blender 5.1+ that provides quick radial menus (pie menus) and modeling utilities to streamline common mesh editing tasks.

Features:
• 9 customizable pie menus with 8-directional options each
• Fast proportional editing with 7 falloff variants
• UV editing tools with integrated seam marking and unwrapping
• One-click mirror workflows with delete-half operations
• Snap and transform utilities for quick modeling
• Built-in hotkey customization via addon preferences
• Supports Blender 5.1 and newer

The addon includes integrated versions of EdgeFlow and UVSquares for complete mesh editing capabilities.
